title: How it works: system diagram explainer (Canvas)
description: A concept/flow diagram explainer: a kicker and title rise in and glide up into a header; 2-6 labelled node cards with code-drawn line icons spring in one per beat, each at the tip of an arrow that draws itself from the previous node; packets stream along every finished arrow; the current node is lit (glow, ring, filled icon disc) while a caption band explains it and the camera leans towards it. The last beat lights the whole system in a wave, speeds up the flow, and lands a takeaway line. Lays out as a row, column, snake grid or loop depending on node count and aspect ratio.

title.description: What the diagram explains; becomes the header after the intro

kicker.description: Small tracked label above the title (empty for none)

nodes.description: Node labels in flow order: the parts or stages of the system, 1-3 words each

default: Your phone sends an encrypted token, never the card number
The shop's checkout asks its processor to charge the token
The network routes the request to the bank that issued the card
The bank checks the balance and approves in under a second
captions.description: One caption line per node, shown while that node is lit (same order; empty string for none)

icons.description: Line icon drawn in each node's disc (same order); auto draws the node's number

takeaway.default: Four hops, about one second, and no card number shared
takeaway.description: Closing line shown while the whole system is lit (empty for none)

layout.description: auto picks a row (landscape) or column (portrait) for up to 4 nodes and a snake grid for 5-6; loop places nodes on an ellipse and draws a closing arrow for cyclic processes

palette.description: Ground, ink, accent (lit nodes, arrows), flow (packets) and muted (idle arrows, borders)

grid.description: Opacity of the drifting graph-paper grid

packets.description: Density of flow packets on the arrows (0 for none)

camera.description: How far the camera leans and pushes towards the current node

notes: Needs `pip install playwright` and `playwright install chromium-headless-shell`.
Uses the system's Inter (fonts-inter) when installed, else Helvetica Neue/Arial.
Beats: intro = clamp(0.13 D, 1.6, 2.6); outro = clamp(0.2 D, 2.2, 3.6); node k pops at intro + k (D - intro - outro) / N + 0.35; the system lights at D - outro and the takeaway lands 0.35 s later.
Render cost measured side by side with scene.steps under identical load: within 5% of it at 1080x1920; vg.grain is about 12% of the total.
